caption_original:
Hey, look at this.

‘It was supposed to rain.’ Seriously.

I was scrolling through my weather app, and the forecast was… completely wrong. It was predicting a heatwave. A *heatwave*! 

Like, I was planning my day around a drizzle, and this app was telling me to slap on the sunscreen. 

It’s wild, right? Makes you wonder about these things.

It just goes to show, sometimes the unexpected is exactly what you need. Keep an open mind, and who knows what amazing surprises are waiting for you today.

Download your weather app and see what it says!
